rdfs:label: proof
rdfs:comment: A cryptographic proof attached to a VerifiableCredential or VerifiablePresentation — what verifiers check to confirm the document hasn't been tampered with and was signed by the claimed party.
notes: An Object carrying the proof type (e.g. `Ed25519Signature2020`, `DataIntegrityProof`), the signature value, and metadata: when, by which key (`verificationMethod`), and for what purpose (`proofPurpose`). Defined in the W3C Security Vocabulary; used unchanged by VC, DID Document signing, and fediverse Object Integrity Proofs (FEP-8b32). (ActivityPub HTTP Signatures sign HTTP headers and do not use `proof`.)

examples.title: A credential with a proof block

history.note: Corrected notes (HTTP Signatures do not use sec:proof; FEP-8b32 does); example and seeAlso use sec:proofPurpose full IRI instead of a non-registry urn:solid proofPurpose term.
